characters.name: Wren Hollis
characters.notes: Enjoys tracking, scouting ahead and finding a way across difficult ground.
characters.backstory: Grew up on the river barges and knows every ford and reed bed. Old Brannoc once pulled her out of the water, and she still owes him for it.
characters.goals: Pay back her debt to the ferryman.

characters.name: Tamsin Reed
characters.notes: Likes talking to NPCs and moral choices; spirits and lost souls draw her in.
characters.backstory: Raised at a wayside shrine where travellers left candles for those lost on the marsh. One candle always burned for a girl who never came back.
characters.goals: Find out who the candle was for and bring her rest.

characters.name: Dorrik Flint
characters.notes: Wants a good fight now and then and likes protecting the others.
characters.backstory: A former caravan guard who lost a cart and its driver to the marsh years ago and never found out what happened.
characters.goals: Prove that the marsh can be crossed safely.

characters.name: Pell Ashby
characters.notes: Enjoys riddles, old records and anything magical that can be studied.
characters.backstory: An apprentice archivist who read about a lantern that burns without oil in a water-stained ledger.
characters.goals: See the lantern with his own eyes and learn how it works.
